items.heading: Tuition
items.text: Tuition-per-year comparisons are misleading here in a specific way: Australia's annual tuition is not wildly higher than the UK's, but Australia charges that tuition for two years instead of one, and adds a second year of living costs, upfront health cover, and a recently doubled visa fee on top.

items.heading: This Is Where the Two
items.text: This is where the two systems diverge the most, and where most agents blur an important distinction: both give you real time to work after graduation, but only one of them is designed to lead somewhere permanent.
